description:
About the Scholarship

Choreomundus investigates dance and movement systems as intangible cultural heritage, and its relaunched Erasmus Mundus edition is run by a consortium led from Vytautas Magnus University with Athens, Clermont Auvergne and Roehampton. Applications for the 2027/2028 intake open on 15 October 2026, and the last campaign used a 1 February closing date.

OpportunityChoreomundus – International Master in Dance Knowledge, Practice and Heritage (Erasmus Mundus)
HostChoreomundus Consortium (VMU)
LocationKaunas (multi-country mobility), Lithuania
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded

Application Deadline1 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Choreomundus investigates dance and movement systems as intangible cultural heritage, and its relaunched Erasmus Mundus edition is run by a consortium led from Vytautas Magnus University with Athens, Clermont Auvergne and Roehampton. Applications for the 2027/2028 intake open on 15 October 2026, and the last campaign used a 1 February closing date.

Programme Highlights

  • Relaunched Erasmus Mundus edition with a new four-university consortium
  • Focus on ethnochoreology, anthropology of dance and heritage studies
  • Application window opens 15 October 2026 with a February closing pattern
  • Unique specialisation connecting movement practice with UNESCO heritage frameworks

Who Should Apply

Graduates in dance, anthropology, cultural studies, heritage, sports science and related humanities fields are the core audience; movement practice itself is valued in the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships of around EUR 1,400 per month for selected students of the new edition.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the Choreomundus website for the application link once the window opens on 15 October 2026 and prepare the standard document set early. Key deadline information: 1 February 2027 (expected); applications open 15 October 2026 for the 2027/2028 intake.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Choreomundus Consortium (VMU)

The Choreomundus consortium, led by Vytautas Magnus University in Kaunas, delivers the Erasmus Mundus master in dance and movement as practical knowledge and heritage with partners in Greece, France and the UK.

Official website: https://choreomundus.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
